title: Agentic Building Blocks: sample API smoke test

steps.caption: Sample API on :5199: health, register, log in (access + refresh token)
steps.out:
$ GET /health/ready
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Correlation-Id: 7db3090901ad684a11d40f547cb3da2c
Healthy

$ POST /auth/register
{"id":"3bee3123df5f4e3c88fae3ee8d1b3263","email":"smoke-1795203360@example.com","roles":["user"],"tenantId":null}  -> 201

$ POST /auth/login
tokenType=Bearer expiresIn=900 accessToken=CfDJ8MkT_vbG5WVI... refreshToken=present

$ GET /auth/me
{"id":"3bee3123df5f4e3c88fae3ee8d1b3263","email":"smoke-1795203360@example.com","roles":["user"],"tenantId":null}  -> 200

steps.caption: Idempotency: the same key and body replays the stored response
steps.out:
$ POST /demo/orders (Idempotency-Key: order-1) #1
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: /demo/orders/ord_70ec4c6c6250
{"orderId":"ord_70ec4c6c6250","total":"7.50 EUR"}

$ POST /demo/orders (same key, same body) #2
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Location: /demo/orders/ord_70ec4c6c6250
Idempotency-Replayed: true
{"orderId":"ord_70ec4c6c6250","total":"7.50 EUR"}

steps.caption: Same key with a different body is refused (409); no key is a 400
steps.out:
$ POST /demo/orders (same key, different body)
{"type":"https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.10","title":"Conflict","status":409,"detail":"This idempotency key was already used with a different request.","instance":"/demo/orders","code":"idempotency.key_reused","traceId":"00-6fee33a3ae93b1c186be24f996eeb033-d8058a438a2531ff-00","correlationId":"6fee33a3ae93b1c186be24f996eeb033"}  -> 409

$ POST /demo/orders (no key)
{"type":"https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.1","title":"Bad Request","status":400,"detail":"The Idempotency-Key header is required for this request.","instance":"/demo/orders","code":"idempotency.key_missing","traceId":"00-6c4937efc244640062823921fcfddd00-ef49f4d6a957ca6c-00","correlationId":"6c4937efc244640062823921fcfddd00"}  -> 400

$ POST /subscriptions/checkout {plus}

$ POST /subscriptions/dev/checkout/{session}/complete (signed fake webhook)

steps.caption: Notifications: delivered through the outbox into the in-app inbox

$ POST /demo/notify-me
{"notificationId":"e007b19b-c202-476d-b905-052b683cdf52"}  -> 202

$ GET /notifications/inbox/unread-count
{"unread":3}  -> 200

$ GET /notifications/inbox (titles)
 - general | Welcome to the demo
 - billing | Your subscription is Active
 - orders | Order received
